author: Mark Atwood
text: Resolved together with bd:JMAP-826m.8 (path (a): propagate mail-server's IdFate algorithm). The new HashMap<Id, IdFate> dedup replaces the prior Vec::contains + retain pattern in both the default get_changes and the get_metadata_changes override, fixing the O(n²) cost in lockstep with the §5.2 omit-both conformance.
